svg.aria-label: TCP congestion window over time: slow start doubles the window every round trip until a threshold, then congestion avoidance adds one segment per round trip; a loss halves the window (multiplicative decrease), giving the sawtooth shape of AIMD.
svg.title: TCP congestion window over time: slow start doubles the window every round trip until a threshold, then congestion avoidance adds one segment per round trip; a loss halves the window (multiplicative decrease), giving the sawtooth shape of AIMD.
svg.text: Throughput ≈ window ÷ RTT. Modern variants: CUBIC (Linux default) and BBR, which models bandwidth and RTT instead of waiting for loss.
